subject: Pilot gateplan: access roadmap, success metrics, and owners
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@novaanalytics.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@novaanalytics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 18:07:00 -0500
Subject: Pilot gateplan: access roadmap, success metrics, and owners

Hi Elena / Samir —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier. Putting the main points and proposed next steps in one place so we can get your pilot live next week. High-level summary we agreed on:

- Pilot scope: 2-week POC to evaluate Redwood Hosted API on two production-like flows (customer support summarization + semantic search).
- Success metrics: median 95th percentile token latency < 450ms, semantic recall @10 >= 0.78 on the provided eval set, and cost per 1k tokens within the target range in the attached spreadsheet.
- Data and security: we will not persist transcripts beyond pilot retention window; you requested SOC 2 evidence and an IP allowlist for outgoing calls.

Proposed immediate actions (owner / due):
1) Access provisioning (Aditya) — temporary API key + SSO invites for pilot engineers (see list below). Target: 11/17 EOD.
2) IP allowlist (Samir) — provide public egress IPs for your environment so we can add them to our firewall rules; target: 11/16 EOD.
3) Success criteria & eval set (Elena) — upload the labeled eval set and baseline metrics; target: 11/16.
4) Pilot kickoff call (All) — 11/18 10:00 AM PT to align on runbook and test harness.

Requested SSO/SSO invite list (please confirm emails):
- nina.singh@novaanalytics.com
- james.wu@novaanalytics.com
- devops-team@novaanalytics.com

Attachments: I am including a draft SOW that lists deliverables and the initial success metrics spreadsheet.

If that looks good I will: 1) spin up a temporary API key and short-lived credentials; 2) create a dedicated pilot project with logging and a per-route token breakdown in the console; and 3) share a short runbook for the kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0117

[Attachment: redwood-pilot-sow-v1.pdf]

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@novaanalytics.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novaanalytics.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot gateplan: access roadmap, success metrics, and owners

Thanks Aditya — this looks great and aligned with our discussion. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Pilot users: add nina.singh@novaanalytics.com, james.wu@novaanalytics.com, and ops@novaanalytics.com (ops@ is read-only).
- IP allowlist: our egress IPs from the staging VPC are 52.48.12.0/24 and 35.182.44.8/29. Please confirm once added.
- Retention: retain logs for 30 days for troubleshooting; we will not store PII in the eval set.

Success metrics: we will share the annotated eval set by 11/16 noon PT. Note we want to run the summarization flow against the last 30 days of transcripts (sample attached).

Also: we need a SOC 2 AICPA statement and your penetration test summary for our security review. If you can attach those, our InfoSec will fast-track the sign-off.

Attaching our internal intake sheet with resources and an initial test harness snapshot.

Elena
VP, Product
Nova Analytics

[Attachment: initial_requirements.xlsx]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Pilot gateplan: access roadmap, success metrics, and owners

Laura / Neha — forwarding Nova's confirmation. Quick internal ownership notes: 

- Neha: lead on access provisioning and security artifacts. Please prepare SOC 2 packet + pen test summary and upload to the secure drive link in the thread. Target 11/17 EOD.
- Laura: lead engineer point for the pilot runbook and temporary keys. Please create a short runbook with expected endpoints, example requests, and the KV cache guidance for summarization flow. Target: 11/18 morning.

Action items I will take now:
- Create a temporary API key scoped to the Nova pilot (expires 12/01/2026). I will paste the key into the secure secrets channel after Laura confirms the recipient emails.
- Add their staging egress prefixes to the allowlist (52.48.12.0/24, 35.182.44.8/29).

If either of you foresee capacity constraints for the requested throughput (they plan for bursty 3 rps, sustained 0.8 rps) flag it here and I will loop Markus.

Thanks — Aditya

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Subject: Pilot kickoff & credentials — temporary keys, SSO invites, IP allowlist (actioned)

Hi Elena / Samir —

All set for the kickoff tomorrow 11/18 10:00 AM PT. Summary of what I completed: 

1) SSO invites: invited nina.singh@novaanalytics.com, james.wu@novaanalytics.com, ops@novaanalytics.com — invites sent (they arrive from no-reply@redwood.com).
2) IP allowlist: added 52.48.12.0/24 and 35.182.44.8/29 to the pilot project firewall rules; please confirm connectivity from staging.
3) Temporary API key: scoped to the pilot project (expires 2026-12-01). For security, I posted the key in the secure secrets channel and emailed a separate one-time access link to the admins (Samir / James). If you need a rotated key for automation we can issue one via the console.
4) SOC 2 / pen test: Neha uploaded the packet here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XYZ-secure (password-protected).

Next steps and timeline:
- 11/18 10:00 AM PT: kickoff call (runbook walkthrough, data ingestion, and baseline test). Owner: Laura.
- 11/19: Smoke tests and baseline metrics; owner: Nova + Laura.
- 11/27: End of pilot (collect results, compare against success criteria). Owner: Elena / Aditya.

Please reply if you want a dedicated Slack channel for run-time logs; I can create one and add the Nova engineers.

Thanks and see you on the call —
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
